project_title: Multi-Agent RAG System with Real-Time Agent Trace & Observability
archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO & TACTICAL MINIMALISM (Command-Center High-Density Developer Aesthetic)
theme: Dark Mode First (Obsidian & Deep Slate with Vibrant High-Contrast Agent Traces)
file_type_notice: Use .js or .jsx file extensions for React components in frontend/src

header.style: Glassmorphism with border-b border-slate-800/80 backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-950/80 text-white z-50 sticky top-0
elements: Brand Logo & Title with Active System Status Glow Indicator
Quick Stat Badges (Indexed Docs, Qdrant Hybrid Status, Active Agents)
Navigation / View Switcher Tabs (Chat Studio, Ingestion Dashboard, System Topology)
Source Filter Quick Toggles (All, Confluence, Word, ServiceNow)
Agent Trace Side Panel Toggle Button with Live Pulse Indicator

main_chat_area.style: Flex-1 flex flex-col h-[calc(100vh-4rem)] max-w-7xl mx-auto w-full p-4 lg:p-6 gap-4 overflow-hidden
features: Streamed message thread with human vs RAG assistant distinction
Inline citation chips with click-to-highlight source preview drawer
Suggested Resolution Card for ServiceNow Incident query outcomes with 1-click apply action
Source Filter Toggle Toolbar (All, Confluence, Word, ServiceNow Tickets)
Interactive Input Bar with hybrid keyword/vector mode indicator, sample query chips, and submit action button

trace_side_panel.style: W-full lg:w-[450px] bg-slate-900/95 border-l border-slate-800 flex flex-col h-full shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-xl transition-all duration-300
sections: Header with Execution Time (ms), Total Tokens, and Qdrant Search Latency
Pipeline Flow Steps (Orchestrator -> Parallel Agents -> Re-ranking -> Grounded Response)
Collapsible Step Details showing tool input parameters, retrieved chunk vector scores, and raw LLM prompt/response
Interactive Chunk Inspector displaying similarity score, hybrid weight (Dense vs Sparse), and text payload

ingestion_status_view.style: Grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6 p-6 bg-slate-900/50 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl
metrics: Confluence Pages Indexed Count & Last Sync Timestamp
ServiceNow Knowledge Base & Support Tickets Processed
Qdrant Hybrid Vector Store Collection Health & Indexing Throughput

testing_and_attributes.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements MUST have explicit data-testid attributes in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a production-grade multi-agent RAG system UI with Google ADK orchestrator patterns and Qdrant hybrid vector search visualization.
Always use .js or .jsx file extensions for frontend React components.
Ensure every chat response includes grounded citations with badge indicators for Confluence, Word docs, and ServiceNow tickets.
Include a dedicated 'Suggested Resolution' visual card when ServiceNow incident data is returned in the answer.
Provide a collapsible side panel for 'Agent Trace / Events' showing pipeline step timeline, tool calls, retrieved chunk scores, and timing.
Include source filter toggle controls (All, Confluence, Word, ServiceNow) that update chat search scopes.
Provide an ingestion status dashboard tab displaying total indexed documents per source and index health metrics.
Add testid attributes to all interactive elements for end-to-end automated testing.
